title: Rafael and the Harbor
author: Beatrix Sandoval
blurb: Lior Thornbury, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
